name: Can decorative trim work increase the value of my home?

mainEntity.name: Can decorative trim work increase the value of my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, decorative trim work can enhance the aesthetic appeal and perceived value of your home. Well-executed trim adds a finished, custom look that can be attractive to potential buyers. It contributes to a home's overall character and can elevate basic rooms to feel more luxurious. While it’s not always a dollar-for-dollar return, quality trim work is generally viewed as an upgrade that improves a home's marketability and charm, especially in competitive real estate markets like Eagle or Kuna.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, decorative trim work enhances home aesthetics and perceived value, making it more appealing to buyers and improving marketability.
